The Hampton Circuit Court, located in Hampton, Virginia, is an essential institution that has been serving the community since its founding. History of Hampton Circuit Court

The Hampton Circuit Court was established in 1634, making it one of the oldest circuit courts in the United States. Since then, the court has undergone numerous changes and significant events that have shaped it into what it is today. For example, during the Civil War, the court's records were burned, leading to the loss of valuable historical documents.

The Role of Hampton Circuit Court in the Community

The Hampton Circuit Court plays a critical role in ensuring justice is served for the community it serves. Criminal cases, civil cases, family law, and probate are some of the areas that this court has jurisdiction over. These cases are presided over by the judges, who are appointed and serve for a specific period.
